definitions.gloss: extraordinary; off the charts; far beyond normal; outrageous
definitions.explanation: Describes something so extreme that it goes beyond the normal scale or range. Can be used for both positive qualities (extraordinary talent) and negative ones (outrageously expensive).

examples.japanese: {桁外|けたはず}れの{才能|さいのう}だ。
あの{選手|せんしゅ}は{桁外|けたはず}れに{速|はや}い。
このレストランは{桁外|けたはず}れに{高|たか}いが、{味|あじ}は{最高|さいこう}だ。
examples.english: This restaurant is outrageously expensive, but the food is superb.

notes: Literally 'off the digit column' — a metaphor from the abacus, where the number exceeds what the columns can represent. {桁|けた} refers to a digit or column in a number. Used as a na-adjective ({桁外|けたはず}れな{金額|きんがく} — an outrageous amount) or adverbially with に ({桁外|けたはず}れに{大|おお}きい — extraordinarily large). Similar expressions: {規格外|きかくがい} (out of specification), {破格|はかく} (exceptional, unheard-of).
